en.pageTitle: Copy YouTube transcripts in one click — YTTS for Chrome
en.description: A transcript card for YouTube that looks built-in. Copy the whole transcript in one click, with or without timestamps. Free, open source, no account.
en.intro: A transcript card right on the watch page. Read it, jump to any moment, copy all of it in one click.
en.trustLine: Always free. No ads. No account.
en.f1Body: Same buttons, fonts and spacing, in light and dark. No logo, no branding.
en.f2Body: Read it as lines, sentences or plain text. Copy it clean, with or without timestamps.
en.f3Body: No AI upsell, no account, no ads, no tracking. Free and open source.
en.previewAltLight: YTTS transcript card on a YouTube watch page in light mode
en.previewAltDark: YTTS transcript card on a YouTube watch page in dark mode
en.a1: Install YTTS from the Chrome Web Store and open a YouTube video. Expand the Transcript card and choose Allow transcripts. YTTS remembers that choice on this device. Then read or copy the text.
en.q2: Does it work with every video?
en.a2: The video needs a transcript available in YouTube. YTTS displays that existing text; it does not transcribe audio, translate videos or generate AI summaries.
en.a3: Transcript text stays in the page’s memory until you leave the video or close the tab. Copying writes it to your clipboard. Display preferences may sync through your browser account; your permission to load transcripts is stored locally.
en.affiliation: An independent open-source project. Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
